title: Why Slow Drains Happen: The Root Cause in Drainage Systems
description: A slow-draining sink or tub is often the first warning sign of a developing blockage within your drainage system. Rather than reaching immediately for harsh chemical drain cleaners, professional plumbers look at how debris accumulates over time. Hair, soap scum, grease, and mineral scale build up along the interior walls of the pipe, gradually restricting water flow. Understanding this problem-and-cause relationship helps prevent total pipe clogs and protects your plumbing infrastructure from unnecessary damage caused by corrosive chemical treatments.
